tagline.en_US: Start a standalone MockServer endpoint. Add expectations through its API to define the responses your test clients should receive.

description.en_US: MockServer mocks, records, and chaos-tests any HTTP or HTTPS dependency an application connects to. It can return canned, templated, or callback responses, or operate as a proxy to inspect and modify real traffic in flight. Additionally, it supports chaos engineering by injecting latency, dropped connections, and errors to test application resilience.
